definitions.explanation: A portable audio device or app that provides recorded commentary and explanations at museums, tourist sites, historic buildings, and other cultural venues.

examples.japanese: {音声|おんせい}ガイドを{借|か}りる。
{美術館|びじゅつかん}で{英語|えいご}の{音声|おんせい}ガイドを{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used an English audio guide at the art museum.

examples.japanese: {音声|おんせい}ガイドのおかげで{展示|てんじ}の{内容|ないよう}がよく{分|わ}かった。
examples.english: Thanks to the audio guide, I understood the exhibits well.

notes:
A compound of {音声|おんせい} (voice/audio) and ガイド (guide). Commonly available at museums, temples, castles, and other cultural sites in Japan. Many venues offer audio guides in multiple languages, making them valuable for foreign visitors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音声|おんせい}ガイドを{借|か}りる: to borrow/rent an audio guide
- {音声|おんせい}ガイドを{返|かえ}す: to return an audio guide
- {音声|おんせい}ガイド{付|つ}き: with audio guide included
- {多言語|たげんご}{音声|おんせい}ガイド: multilingual audio guide

PRACTICAL NOTE:
Audio guides at Japanese museums typically cost 500-600 yen to rent. Increasingly, venues offer smartphone-based audio guides via QR codes or dedicated apps, sometimes at no extra cost.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ガイドブック: guidebook — a printed travel guide
- パンフレット: pamphlet/brochure — the printed materials available at venues
